title: School Play
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother George.
lines.zh: 我是佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治。

lines.en: This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig. Peppa Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈。这是猪爸爸。小猪佩奇。

lines.en: School Play
Peppa's play group are going to put on a play. The Little Red Riding Hood. Hooray!
lines.zh: 佩奇剧组要上演话剧。小红帽。万岁！

lines.en: All the children have parts in the play. They have to practice at home.
lines.zh: 所有的孩子都在剧中扮演角色。他们必须在家练习。

lines.en: Peppa is going to be Little Red Riding Hood.
Mummy Pig has made her costume. Daddy Pig is helping Peppa practice.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈做了服装。猪爸爸正在帮助佩奇练习。

lines.en: OK Peppa, what do you say?
I'm Little Red Riding Hood.
Very good. Then what?
I'm going to visit my Grandma.
I'm going to visit my Grandma.
Bravo Peppa!
Danny Dog is going to play the Big Bad Wolf.
lines.zh: 小狗丹尼要扮演大灰狼。

lines.en: Grandad Dog and Mummy Dog are helping him practice.
lines.zh: 狗爷爷和狗妈妈正在帮他练习。

lines.en: I'm the Big Bad Wolf.
Try not to laugh Danny.
You should be a bit scarier. Try it like this Danny.
lines.zh: 你应该更可怕一点。像丹尼一样尝试一下。

lines.en: I'm the Big Bad Wolf. I'm going to eat you all up.
lines.zh: 我是大灰狼。我要把你们都吃掉。

lines.en: You see?
Yes, that was really scary.
Pedro Pony is going to play the Hunter. He will rescue Peppa from the Big Bad Wolf.
lines.zh: 佩德罗小马将扮演猎人。他将从大灰狼手中救出佩奇。

lines.en: I'm the Hunter and...
Pedro is a bit shy.
You say, I'm going to chase you away you Big Bad Wolf.
lines.zh: 你说，我要把你赶走，你这个大灰狼。

lines.en: Go away naughty wolf.
Very good Pedro.
Rebecca Rabbit is going to be the Grandma.
lines.zh: 小兔瑞贝卡要当奶奶了。

lines.en: What do I say Mummy?
Let's see.
At the start of the play you get locked in a cupboard by the Big Bad Wolf.
lines.zh: 在游戏开始时，你被大灰狼锁在橱柜里。

lines.en: Then right at the end of the play you are rescued by the Hunter.
lines.zh: 然后在游戏结束时你被猎人救了。

lines.en: And you say, thank you.
Thank you.
Very good Rebecca.
Everyone has come to see the school play.
lines.zh: 大家都来看学校的演出了。

lines.en: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to our play, The Little Red Riding Hood.
lines.zh: 女士们先生们，欢迎观看我们的戏剧《小红帽》。

lines.en: First, let us meet the actors.
lines.zh: 首先让我们来认识一下演员们。

lines.en: Please, please, for the sake of the actors, no photography please.
lines.zh: 拜托拜托，为了演员的缘故，请勿拍照。

lines.en: And now our play begins.
lines.zh: 现在我们的比赛开始了。

lines.en: Grandma is at home.
But who is this visitor?
I'm the Big Bad Wolf.
Well done Danny.
Oh dear, Danny has forgotten what he says next.
lines.zh: 哦天哪，丹尼忘了他接下来要说什么。

lines.en: Grandma, you must go in the cupboard.
Go in the cupboard.
The Big Bad Wolf is pretending to be Grandma.
I am Little Red Riding Hood.
I'm going to visit my Grandma.
Bravo Peppa.
Daddy, you must not take photos.
Oops, sorry Peppa, carry on.
I'm going to visit my Grandma.
Oh, you don't look like my Grandma.
lines.zh: 哦，你看起来不像我奶奶。

lines.en: What big eyes you have.
What big teeth you have.
You are not Grandma, you are the Big Bad Wolf.
lines.zh: 你不是奶奶，你是大灰狼。

lines.en: Help, oh help.
But look who is here, just in time, Pedro the Hunter.
lines.zh: 但是看看谁来了，来得正是时候，猎人佩德罗。

lines.en: Help, oh help.
Just in time, Pedro the Hunter.
lines.zh: 来得正是时候，猎人佩德罗。

lines.en: Pedro is a bit shy.
Pedro, would you like me to come on with you?
lines.zh: 佩德罗，你愿意我和你一起去吗？

lines.en: Yes please.
You are a very naughty wolf.
lines.zh: 你是一只非常调皮的狼。

lines.en: I saved you Grandma.
Hooray.
Thank you.
Bravo.
Pedro, you were very good.
You were almost as good as me.
